title: Consolidate monthly release digest and stakeholder signoff
creator: Leila Patel
description: Create a single, customer-ready monthly release digest that combines internal release notes, a short customer changelog, and a GTM communication checklist. Coordinate review windows and signoffs across Eng, Design, Docs, Legal, and Growth so the digest can be published in the customer portal and emailed to opted-in accounts.
tasks: Aggregate PR summaries and high-impact runtime changes from ENG-4201 and ENG-4320
Draft customer-facing 3-bullet changelog and 1-paragraph summary for top features/regressions
Run tabletop signoff meeting with Eng, Design, Docs, Legal, Growth, and Support
Produce two-channel assets: portal changelog entry and emailed digest template
Finalize links to supporting artifacts: design spec, GitHub PRs, performance dashboard
Publish changelog entry in Console and schedule email via Growth Ops
acceptance_criteria: Customer-facing changelog paragraph + bullets approved by Product and Legal
Internal detailed release notes uploaded to Confluence with engineering links
Signoff captured from Eng lead, Design lead, Docs owner, Legal counsel, and Growth lead
Email digest scheduled and tested in staging environment with correct link to portal
Console changelog entry visible to Tiered customers and free-tier users as appropriate
